snippet.title: HEXALIS — Gameplay | Color Strategy Game
snippet.description:
Watch a full match of HEXALIS, a color strategy game. Choose colors, expand your territory, and outsmart two AI opponents.

This video shows real gameplay from the start of the match to the final result.
